rightsNote: FILM COPYRIGHT: not renewed. Verified 2026-07-29 against CCE 3rd Series Parts 12-13, renewal sections 1968-1971 (eight half-year volumes), by OCR full-text search plus alphabetical-neighbourhood checks on the page scans. The negative is substantive rather than accidental: the same volumes show Paramount's 1941 one-reelers renewed in bulk by Supat Industries (e.g. Snow Dogs, M11369 -> R442320, 11 Sep 1968), so the renewal machinery was demonstrably running across this library and these shorts are simply not in it. This is the best published evidence short of a formal Copyright Office search report (Form 4). Every CCE renewal page carries the Office's own footer noting the printed entries alone may not reflect the complete record, and pre-1978 renewals are not in the online database. SEPARATE AND LIVE: non-renewal clears the FILM only. The Superman CHARACTER has its own live chain of title (DC / National Periodical, whose renewals DO appear in these same volumes) plus trademark rights. That is a distinct question, unresolved here, and should be reviewed by counsel before publication. Operationally: play the films, never use Superman in dumbTV marketing, artwork, or store copy.
